name: Feralas: A History
summary: You find a book that looks as if nobody has opened it in ages, and it may be exactly what Troyas needs. It belongs to Daryn Lightwind, so you need to ask whether you may borrow it.

sections.title: A Neglected Book
sections.body: The book's covers are badly worn and its pages have yellowed. After looking it over, you suspect it may be what Troyas is searching for. You pick it up, then think better of borrowing it without asking. It is Daryn Lightwind's, so she should be asked first.

sections.title: Daryn's Answer
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind takes a moment to think it over. She will let you borrow Feralas: A History, though only after you have done a favor for her.

faq.q: What is the book Feralas: A History?
faq.answer: A book with worn covers and yellowed pages, which looks as if it has not been opened for ages. It may be exactly what Troyas is searching for.
Daryn Lightwind. You should ask her before borrowing it.
It follows In Search of Knowledge, in which Troyas Moonbreeze sent you to talk to Daryn Lightwind about his stave.
